title: Warmly Fermented Syrian Dough Flatbread
description: A traditional Syrian flatbread made with fermented dough and topped with candied peel, perfect for a light and delicious snack
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl
Gradually add water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 24 hours
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces
Roll out each piece into a thin circle
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with candied orange peel
Place the flatbreads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for 15 minutes
Remove the flatbreads from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack
